why: The agent did not gather diffs since the last deploy in a form that shows what the deploy will change: it ran one cumulative diff (commit 1 to 3) and never diffed commit 2, so it could not say which action commit 2 adds. It also never showed the owner the actual diff, only a vague summary ('inspect and renew, or one of them'). The confirmation request is therefore not based on a proper review of the changes.
